messages:
sara: Quick question 1: we're evaluating InvoiceSmith vs LedgerLens for invoice automation. Procurement forwarded both proposals but the pricing units differ. anyone who dug into either?
alex: I ran a quick sandbox with LedgerLens last month. Pros: very flexible connector layer, good line-item extraction. Cons: their pricing is two-part (per-invoice + per-field-extraction).
liam: that per-field model sounds annoying. do you have the exact numbers?
alex: LedgerLens quoted: $0.10 per invoice + $0.005 per extracted field (line items counted as fields), enterprise plan has $40k min commit. POC offered 4 weeks free.
sara: InvoiceSmith's sheet is different: flat $0.12 per invoice or $0.08 if we commit 200k/mo, plus $0.01 per PDF page for OCR-heavy docs. no field-level charge but line-item completeness SLA only on enterprise.
emma: finance-ops requirements summary: 1) must provide an S3 batch export + webhook for reconciled payloads 2) audit log for every reconciliation event (retain 7 years) 3) must support multi-currency and FX adjustments in the output schema 4) processing window SLA: <6h for daily batches, <30m for critical invoices 5) DPA + KMS/HSM support.
liam: add to email: ask whether "per-invoice" includes line-item level detail. we reconcile to GL lines. if they give only header totals it's useless.
procurement-bot: Reminder: attach vendor proposals and our sample export. Use /procure/reply-template-v3.
sara: Drafting vendor questions 1: please comment/trim: 
- Can you ingest our GCS export CSV format? Any schema mapping gaps?
- Does your per-invoice price include line-item extraction and tax/discount detail?
- How do you price PDFs with many embedded images/attachments? Do you charge per page?
- Do you offer stepped volume discounts at 50k / 150k / 300k monthly thresholds?
- Is SSO (SAML + SCIM) included or extra?
- Can reconciliation rules be exported (YAML/JSON) and version controlled?
- Do you provide a sandbox for accuracy benchmarking against our sample set?
- Will you sign our standard DPA and accept KMS/HSM key control requirements?
- Do you provide an error-level SLA and a 30-day exit clause if accuracy < agreed benchmark after onboarding?
- What is the typical onboarding effort (hours) and PS cost vs included hours?

alex: I'd add: ask them for a sample invoice showing cost at our projected volume (we put 1.5M invoices/yr). request a 12/24 month price schedule.
liam: negotiation levers to consider in reply: commit tiers for lower per-invoice, waive per-page fees for compressed multipage PDFs, include X hours PS in first year, include retention + audit log at no extra.
emma: Also confirm residency (US/EU) and ability to sign a SOC2 addendum. We cannot accept EU-only data routing without contract language.
sara: Great. I'll send a consolidated RFP reply now and paste vendor replies back here. tagging @alex and @liam for quick review. :mailbox_with_mail:
